name: Oath of the Ebon Blade Spells

description.value:
The magic of your oath and your Runeforging feature keep certain spells always ready: when you reach a Paladin level shown in the Oath of the Ebon Blade Spells table, you thereafter always have the spell of the Spells (All) column prepared, plus the spells of the column of the rune inscribed on your weapon, if any.
